compiled_state.description:
## Summary
Operator must run /reload-plugins after amendment commits merge to the session branch, so the orchestrator's plugin cache reflects the amended skill/agent files.

## Done Definitions
- Operator runs /reload-plugins and confirms reload succeeds
- Verification command passes: diff of plugin cache vs repo skills directory shows no differences
- Confirmation recorded so S11 self-application can proceed

## Verification Command
ACTIVE_VERSION=$(ls -t ~/.claude/plugins/cache/digital-service-orchestra/dso-dev/ | head -1)
diff -q <(cd "$HOME/.claude/plugins/cache/digital-service-orchestra/dso-dev/$ACTIVE_VERSION/skills" && find . -type f -name '*.md' | sort | xargs sha256sum) <(cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/skills" && find . -type f -name '*.md' | sort | xargs sha256sum) >/dev/null

## SC Coverage
SC8 (unblocks S11 self-application)
